consumerRules: Validate and apply every known command in order.
For join-admission, verify top-level IDs match ticketClaims before creating host transport state.
For join-admission, require ticketClaims.clientIceUfrag to match clientIce.ufrag when present.
For join-admission, recompute ticketClaims.offerFingerprintHash from the DTLS fingerprints in clientOffer.sdp before creating host transport state.
For join-admission, recompute ticketClaims.playerIdentityHash from the redacted player summary when present; hold acknowledgement on mismatch.

For join-admission, compare ticketClaims.expiresAt epoch milliseconds against AgentControlResponse.serverTime; Warden filters expired join-admissions before polling, but consumers must still reject expired commands defensively.
For join-admission, treat clientOffer.sdp as sensitive volatile transport metadata; it is stripped of a=identity assertions but still contains client ICE credentials and DTLS fingerprints.
For join-admission, treat player as an optional redacted verified-identity summary; use it for enrichment and diagnostics only, never as a replacement for ticket or SDP validation.
Use clientOffer.sdp as the remote offer when creating the lazy host PeerConnection; do not write it to normal logs or durable support artifacts.
Persist accepted join admissions by answerIce.ufrag plus clientIce.ufrag; the first STUN packet exposes ICE username fragments, not a Warden decision ID.
Report join-admission.ticketId on ticket lifecycle events; it is a redacted Warden ticket identifier, not the transport admission key.
Treat expired join-admission as handled only after recording a terminal ticket.failed outcome.
Acknowledge page.cursor only after every command in the page is durably handled or intentionally discarded.
If any command cannot be safely handled, do not acknowledge the cursor; replay is preferred to silent command loss.

clientOffer.sdp:
v=0
o=- 1234567890 2 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
s=-
t=0 0
a=group:BUNDLE 0
m=application 9 UDP/DTLS/SCTP webrtc-datachannel
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=ice-ufrag:client-ufrag-valid
a=ice-pwd:client-password-valid
a=fingerprint:sha-256 00:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF:00:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF
a=setup:actpass
a=mid:0
a=sctp-port:5000
a=max-message-size:262144
